why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Install a Solana wallet such as Phantom or Solflare on your Android phone.

Download the ORVI app from Google Play. Warning The "Mint Your NFT" link on the old memebook.app site leads to an address that no longer exists. Don't mint from lookalike sites that claim to replace it.
Sign in with your wallet. This is a message signature that costs no gas, and ORVI's terms say: "We never ask for, receive or store your private key or seed phrase."
Finish the short entry quest to get the free tier.
Post, comment and check in daily to build XP and a streak.
Open the claim page on orvi.fun with the same wallet to see whether an early user reward is recorded for you.
costs: Joining is free. ORVI's FAQ says: "Reading, posting and commenting cost nothing". A tip sends 95% to the creator and 5% to the platform, and tips and mints cost a Solana network fee. Tier passes are optional, and their price isn't published. The app shows ads.
risks: Two brands run side by side. The memebook.app site and its X account still talk about $MBK, while the ORVI site and account never mention it. The MEXC "Airdrop+" promotion for $MBK is an exchange trading campaign that needs a deposit and trades. It isn't a reward for app users. You must be 18 or older.
